easy.def: A very long story about heroes.
examples: We read an epic.
The epic is long.
An epic about a hero.

more.def: A very long story or poem about the brave adventures of heroes.
examples: The ancient epic tells of a hero's long trip home from a war.
We listened to a part of the epic every night.
The movie was an epic about explorers who sailed around the world.
It was an epic game.
An epic trip.
An epic adventure.

more.def: Very big, long and exciting, like the adventures in a great story.
examples: Their trip across the country was an epic adventure.
It was an epic battle between the two best teams.
The epic movie was three hours long.

easy.def: When a sickness spreads to many people.
examples: A flu epidemic hit the town.
The epidemic spread fast.
The epidemic ended.

more.def: A time when a sickness spreads quickly to many people.
examples: A flu epidemic closed the schools for a week.
Doctors worked hard to stop the epidemic.
The epidemic ended when the weather warmed.
I watched an episode.
The episode was funny.
This is my favorite episode.

more.def: One show or part of a TV series or book.
examples: We watched a new episode of the show.
The last episode ended with a surprise.
Each episode is thirty minutes long.
